hypothesis: Pitchers carry stable count- and handedness-dependent repertoire tilts across seasons. A completed-season hierarchical pitch-group table can transfer those tilts onto the current row's official as-of repertoire prior, improving the deployable pitch-type mixture without observing the current pitch type.

selection_contract.label: official historical TrackMan pitch_type_group matched by row_id
selection_contract.metric: minimize worst multiclass log loss, then mean multiclass log loss, then candidate_id

history_contract.cutoff: season strictly less than prediction season
history_contract.parent: pitcher-level pitch-group distribution shrunk to the historical regular-season group frequency with K=100
history_contract.cell: context distribution shrunk to its pitcher parent
history_contract.transfer: multiply the current row official as-of repertoire prior by the historical cell-to-pitcher probability ratio raised to tau, then normalize
